title: 日本ダービーの後に・二冠達成

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After seizing victory in the Japanese Derby, Symboli Rudolf raises two fingers high: two crowns. The Classic Triple Crown is starting to look like a real possibility.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She resolves to claim the final crown in the Kikuka Sho, but her packed schedule is starting to take its toll, and Air Groove is only getting more concerned.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As usual, however, it's Symboli Rudolf's way or the highway. Even a grueling race can't keep her from her student council duties.
